en: A black and white postcard showing a large, multi-story institutional building with a clock and a crest at the top, surrounded by neatly maintained grounds with a rectangular pond or pool in the foreground. Several people are seen walking or relaxing by the water and in the gardens. There are trees, lamp posts, and several parked vehicles from the mid-20th century. The text on the postcard identifies the location and the publisher.
